description.en: Creates a light (Low) model of the story character para_cpNNNN, dressed in the given kit: CMND_CREATE_CHARA(4, _charaName, "dmmy", _face, _body, false, _home, _keeper, shoes, gloves, _ev, false, _mem), where shoes = _body and gloves = _body for a goalkeeper, 0 otherwise. Unless _no_bustup is true, it also creates the character's bust-up picture (CreateBustup) named after the object with "顔" (face) appended. Wait for it with WaitLoading.
Name of the new object; the events use the character's name followed by L (light model) or H (detailed model).
Character number: the model is para_cpNNNN (the developers named this argument _face).
Body (kit) number; also used as the shoes number, and as the gloves number for a goalkeeper.
true for the home kit, false for away.
true for the goalkeeper outfit (gloves get the body number).
Passed as CMND_CREATE_CHARA's ev flag (choice between two light settings).
true to skip the bust-up picture.
Handle of the new character (see CMND_CREATE_CHARA).

examples.case: A character in the away kit (real usage, from ev42010400.nut; the Shift-JIS object name is replaced by a variable here)
